sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Agonist (SR-58611A) dose-response cAMP assay in HEK293 cells: cAMP formation was comparable between untagged ADRβ3 and HA-ADRβ3-GFP, indicating the HA tag has no effect on receptor function.
sites.rationale: ADRB3 is a GPCR with no signal peptide; the topology landmarks place residues 1–36 extracellular and TM1 beginning at residue 37. The paper explicitly places the HA tag at the 'extracellular N-terminus' of the full-length, membrane-anchored receptor, which resolves to a single junction: a prepend before residue 1 (insert_after_residue=0, residue_after=M). The 36-residue extracellular N-terminal stretch provides ample distance (>3 aa) from the TM1 boundary. Functional validation by cAMP assay confirms surface_and_function status. Full-length ADRB3 cloned into pLenti-C-mGFP with HA tag at the extracellular N-terminus and GFP at the intracellular C-terminus (HA-ADRβ3-GFP); expressed in HEK293 cells. Paper states 'HA tag at the extracellular N-terminus' without naming a specific residue number. ADRB3 has no signal peptide (topology landmarks confirm residues 1–36 are extracellular), so exactly one extracellular N-terminal junction exists: before residue 1 (insert_after_residue=0).

literature_notes: The ledger (L1–L8) supports only N-terminal extracellular tags for ADRB3. L1–L5 (PMC8199065) describe an HA tag at the extracellular N-terminus with full functional validation (cAMP assay). L6–L8 (PMC6378987) describe a FLAG tag at the N-terminus confirmed by non-permeabilized FACS. Both resolve to the same junction (insert_after_residue=0) because ADRB3 has no signal peptide and residues 1–36 are the sole extracellular N-terminal span. No ledger line supports any internal ECL insertion (ECL1: 98–111, ECL2: 175–203, ECL3: 315–327). The C-terminal GFP (L1/L5) is intracellular and placed in other_positions. Palmitoylation sites mentioned in L6/L8 (Cys-153, Cys-292, Cys-361/363) are not tag-insertion sites and are not included.

literature_other_positions.note: GFP fused to the intracellular C-terminus of full-length ADRB3 (residues 347–408 are intracellular per topology landmarks); not a surface-accessible site.
